name: Bladestorm 1
description: A storm of slashes that cascades outward, striking the enemies within 3 tiles.

name: Bravado
description: A finisher that instantly kills normal enemies (15%> hp).  Kill restores 30% of your health and 15% of team's.  Also restores 7.5% mana to group. Otherwise deals damage based on STR and 6.7% of max health  Instant kills reduce cooldown by half.

name: Challenge 1
description: Taunts every enemy within 3 tiles for a few seconds.

name: Glory
description: A finisher that instantly kills normal enemies (20%> hp).  Kill restores 40% of your health and 20% of team's. Otherwise deals damage based on STR and 9% of max health. Also restores 10% mana to group.  Instant kills reduce cooldown by half.  Pure only.

name: Rout 1
description: A sweeping blow that strikes the enemies directly beside you.  It costs no health.

name: Sever 1
description: An attack that strikes enemies up to 4 tiles in front of you, stopping at walls.  Damage scales with your health.

name: Shockwave 1
description: An attack that cascades outward in a cone, dealing massive damage to enemies up to 4 tiles in front of you.

name: Vanguard Sweep 1
description: An assail that sweeps enemies directly beside you, but not diagonally.
